slides.title: Pilot goals
bullets: Reduce site check-in time from 8 minutes to under 5 minutes
Reach at least 85% weekly active use across the 24 pilot technicians
Capture support issues within one business day

slides.title: First 30 days
bullets: Days 1–3: provision accounts and run supervisor training
Days 4–10: launch at Harbor and Juniper sites
Days 11–21: review adoption and resolve blockers
Days 22–30: decide whether to expand to Alder site
